answer: Each lagoon agent deposits 0.4 saffron threads into a summit vault; threads are burned linearly at 0.05 threads per second during activity windows, and only a burned fraction unlocks a gate seal. A Sybil must deposit fresh threads each second, costing 0.05 saffron per second per head, a cost that scales directly with time and cannot be pooled since the summit’s vault thread count resets continuously.
